text:
maria-cs: FYI Embark onboarding is failing for their first-run demo — they see a flurry of 429s during SDK init and occasional 401 handshakes. Demo is tomorrow. Can we triage quick?
ben-eng: On it. Do we have a sample log or exact error payloads? 429s during init usually mean preflight fanout or token refresh stampede.
sam-support: Customer pasted this snippet in support ticket:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-20T18:12:03Z","level":"warn","path":"/v1/sdk/init","client":"embark","status":429,"msg":"preflight queue full"}
{"ts":"2026-03-20T18:12:04Z","level":"error","path":"/v1/auth/handshake","client":"embark","status":401,"msg":"invalid token signature"}
```
ben-eng: Thanks. Two quick hypotheses: 1) client is doing concurrent preflight requests from many workers (thundering herd). 2) token refresh flow is renewing per request / lacking splay, causing auth backend to spike.
ops-julia: Can we confirm whether they use ephemeral tokens + refresh on every call? If yes, advise immediate mitigation: add a small token cache and splay refresh timing.
maria-cs: They said they refresh tokens on each worker start and occasionally per request in our SDK example — probably the cause. Customer using serverless functions behind a scheduler, so lots of cold starts.
ben-eng: Short-term playbook I recommend we give them now:
- Reduce simultaneous preflight concurrency (client-side) to 4-8
- Add jittered token refresh splay (500-2000ms)
- Enable connection reuse / keepalive so auth handshake isn't repeated per request
- Add exponential backoff on 429s with capped retries
Example config snippet to paste into their integration:
```js
// recommended SDK tweaks
sdk.init({
  preflightConcurrency: 6, // limit parallel preflight probes
  preflightBackoffMs: 300,
  tokenRefresh: {
    cacheMs: 300000, // cache token for 5 min
    splayMs: 500 + Math.random()*1500
  },
  http: { keepAlive: true }
});
```
sam-support: Also ask them to check system clock skew on their hosts — invalid token signatures often come from clock drift.
ops-julia: On the server side we can temporarily increase the preflight window and relax strict per-second client quotas for this tenant for the next 24h while they finish onboarding. I can file the quota lift — we should log it.
maria-cs: Please do that, julia. I will send the config snippet to Embark and set up a 20-min troubleshooting call in 15. Can someone join? @ben-eng can you spare 20?
ben-eng: Yep, I can hop on. Also will enable a short-term debug trace for their client id — should help confirm whether token refresh is the root cause.
deploy-bot: [deploy-notice] infra: temporary quota-lift for client=embark scheduled by ops-julia — will auto-revert in 24h. :white_check_mark:
maria-cs: Thanks all — will update the ticket with the asks and add call details. :thumbsup:
